lines.text: &fKits are sets of items the server gives out. Each card is one kit.
&7The kit's icon and name, and under them its state: &aReady&7, &6Ready in&7 a countdown, &8claimed&7 for a one-time kit, or &clocked&7 when you do not have this kit (yet).
&7Some kits have a description under the state, written by the staff.
&fPreview&7 shows what the kit holds, laid out like your inventory. It works for locked kits too.
&fClaim&7 puts the items in your inventory; what does not fit drops at your feet. A kit then waits its cooldown, or is gone for good if it is a one-time kit.
